## Article checklist

- [ ] File is `content/posts/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md` and the slug is unique
- [ ] Front matter is complete (title, author, categories, tags, image, description)
- [ ] I added or confirmed my entry in `content/authors.json`
- [ ] Every command and code snippet was run by me. Godot version tested: ____
- [ ] Facts link to official docs, release notes or the project repo. No invented quotes, stats or testimonials
- [ ] Images are mine or I have the right to use them, and they have alt text
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run check-urls` pass
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes, no filler
